citations.context: Now the sword will not turn aside from your house forever, because you despised me and took the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be a wife for yourself. Note the chiastic structure. You took his wife, you struck with a sword, the sword will not turn aside, you took as wife. Thus says Yahweh, I am about to raise up against you evil from your house, and I am about to take your wives before your eyes and give them to your neighbor, and he will lie with your wives before the eyes of this son, because you yourself did it in secret, but I myself will do this thing before all Israel and before the sun.
